FIELDS.NAME: Elegant Spaces Interior Design
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Elegant Spaces Interior Design, we specialize in creating personalized, stylish, and functional interior environments for residential clients. Our core operations include design consultation, space planning, color selection, and furnishing recommendations, all tailored to meet the unique needs and preferences of our clients. We focus on non-structural design elements, ensuring that our services do not involve general construction or structural remodeling, which helps to mitigate liability. Our team employs industry-standard design software to visualize concepts and facilitate decision-making for our clients, while maintaining a secure digital storage system to protect sensitive client information. We are committed to providing exceptional customer service, clear communication, and comprehensive project documentation, including formal contracts and detailed change orders, to ensure accountability and satisfaction throughout the design process.

Our team specializes in creating beautiful interior spaces, often involving structural remodeling, including demolition and load-bearing modifications, to achieve the perfect design for our clients.
